notes.title: "Monsters of Moldred" will be in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Von Optimum here - the sole creator of "Monsters of Moldred".

[b]I wanted to announce that Monsters of Moldred will be in the upcoming Steam Next Fest in February!
The demo will be available a week or two before Next Fest starts.[/b]

The current state of the game is what I'd consider to be alpha.
[b]Depending on the interest shown during Next Fest (such as wishlists gained and posts on the game's discussion board), I'll know for sure whether to continue working on this title or not.[/b]

So, please let me know what you think of the game (keeping in mind it isn't complete)!

Also, before playing, please take note of the following...

[list]
[*] The game may (and will) have bugs or other oddities. While the demo is available I will try to address any major technical issues experienced (please post them on the discussion board).
[*] Not all content is present. An example being the hunters' visual appearances come in only two types as of now, representing only one male and one female. The final game would have these appearances randomly chosen/generated. Most text/narration are not final either. Graphics may change. More presentation flair (including animations) would be desirable. And audio is pretty much non existent. Balancing of basically everything has only been done by me initially and not fully tested.
[*] This Demo shows only the Quest portion of the game. The final game would have another, lighter, layer of gameplay on top where you choose what Quest to go on from a list given by different Monster Houses.
[/list]


[b]I look forward to hearing everyone's thoughts on the potential of Monsters of Moldred. Feedback/Wishlists will for certain decide whether this game will release or not.[/b]

Thanks for your time and attention,
Von Optimum
Regal Bread Studio
